original: じゃあ、どうするんだ？
traducao: So, what are we gonna do?

original: 決まってるだろ。\n迎えに行くよ
traducao: That's obvious.\nWe're gonna go pick him up.

original: あんな動くわいせつ物、\nその辺に放置してたら、\n人様に迷惑がかかるからね
traducao: If we leave that walking\npublic nuisance alone,\nhe'll cause trouble for everyone.

original: よう、○○
traducao: Hey there, ○○.

original: 来てたのか、気付かなくてごめんな
traducao: You were here? Sorry, I didn't notice.

original: ……そうだ、悪いんだけど\n良かったら○○も\n手を貸してくれないかい？
traducao: ...Oh, sorry to ask,\nbut would you mind\nlending us a hand, ○○?

original: 知り合いに、どうしようもない馬鹿が\n一人いてさ。　これからそいつを\n迎えに行かなきゃなんないんだよ
traducao: We know an incorrigible idiot.\nAnd now we have to go\npick him up.

original: あ、俺からも頼むよ。\nもちろん、俺で良ければ手伝うからさ
traducao: Yeah, I'm asking too.\nI'll be there to help out, of course.

original: 全く、懲りないっていうか\n何ていうか……
traducao: Seriously, he never learns\nhis lesson or whatever...

original: ほんとに、手のかかる馬鹿だよ。\nあいつは
traducao: He's such a high-maintenance idiot.\nHe really is.

original: クエスト「愛の使者、襲来」が\nエントリーされました。\nしいなから受ける事が出来ます
traducao: The quest "Envoy of Love Arrives" has\nbeen added. You can accept it\nfrom Sheena.

original: 手を貸してくれるんだね、助かるよ。\nあの馬鹿はあたし一人じゃ\n手に負えなくってサ
traducao: Thanks for helping out. I appreciate it.\nI can't handle that idiot\nall by myself.

original: ああ、美人を\n連れて来いって条件かい？
traducao: Ah, his condition of bringing\na beauty along?

original: 真に受けなくていいよ。\nいつものあいつのしょうもない病気さ
traducao: Don't take it seriously.\nIt's just his usual stupid sickness.

original: それに、あたしが同行すれば\nあいつも黙ると思うしね
traducao: Besides, if I go with you,\nI think he'll shut up.

original: ……あ、いや、別にあたしが\n美人だって言ってるわけじゃないよ？
traducao: ...Ah, no, I'm not saying\nthat I'm a beauty or anything!

original: あいつには、そろそろ、きつ〜いお灸を\n据えてやんなきゃって思ってるだけさ
traducao: I just think it's about time\nhe gets a harsh punishment!

original: さ、行こう
traducao: Let's go.

original: やれやれ、全く……
traducao: Good grief, seriously...

original: 何で、こんなとこで\n迷っちまうかねぇ……
traducao: Why did he have to\nget lost in a place like this...

original: ああ、ごめんよ。\n愚痴っぽくなっちまったね
traducao: Ah, sorry.\nI ended up complaining.

original: ……これから迎えに行く馬鹿はサ、\n重度の女好きなんだ
traducao: ...The idiot we're picking up\nis a massive womanizer.

original: 今回も「ロイドくんを追っかけて\nアドリビトムを目指してるぜ∀」なんて\nしゃあしゃあと言っちゃあいるけど……
traducao: This time he said something like,\n"I'm following Lloyd to Ad Libitum!"\nso shamelessly, but...

original: ホントの目的なんて\n言わずとも……っていう奴だよ
traducao: Needless to say, it's obvious\nwhat his true motive is...

original: ○○も気を付けなよ。\nあいつ、ほんと女には\n全力で見境ないからさ
traducao: You be careful too, ○○.\nHe truly goes all out and has no\nboundaries when it comes to women.

original: ……なんて、\nうだうだ言ってたって仕方ないね
traducao: ...Well,\ncomplaining won't get us anywhere.

original: それじゃ、気合入れていくよ！
traducao: Let's get fired up and go!

original: 待ってたぜ、俺さまの可愛い\n子猫ちゃん達∀
traducao: I've been waiting for you,\nmy cute little kittens!

original: お嬢さん……。\n俺さまの為に、はるばるこんな所まで……
traducao: Little lady...\nYou came all this way just for me...

original: ここでこうしてお会い出来たのも\n何かのご縁。\nよろしければ……
traducao: Meeting you here like this\nmust be fate.\nIf you'd like...

original: その疲れたおみ足、俺さまが\nもみほぐしてあげちゃいた〜い、みたいな∀
traducao: I'd love to massage\nthose tired legs of yours!

original: って、何だよ。\nこっちはヤローか
traducao: Wait, what the heck.\nThis one's a dude.

original: で、で
traducao: So, so!

original: 俺さまの俺さまによる俺さまの為の\n可愛い可愛い子猫ちゃん達∀は\nどこに……
traducao: Where are the cute, cute little kittens\nmade of me, by me,\nand for me...?

original: ゼロス！！！
traducao: Zelos!!!

original: ぐはっ！！？
traducao: Guhah!!?

original: ……って、しいな？\n何でぇ、お前もこの愛の使者たる\n俺さまに会いたくて来ちゃったってか？
traducao: ...Wait, Sheena?\nWhat, did you come because you wanted to\nsee the Envoy of Love too?

original: か〜〜っ、モテる男は辛いねえ∀
traducao: Ah, it's tough being a popular guy!

original: ごほぉっ！！？
traducao: Gahak!!?

original: ……って、何度も人を殴るなっつの！
traducao: ...Hey, stop hitting people!

original: そうでもしなきゃ、\nあんたのそのくだらないお喋りは\n止まらないだろ？
traducao: If I don't do that,\nyou'd never stop your\nstupid blabbering, right?

original: な、何だよ。\nそんな目くじら立てなくたって\nいいでしょ〜
traducao: W-What's the big deal.\nYou don't have to get\nso angry about it~

original: 今日という今日は、\nきつ〜〜〜〜〜くお灸を\n据えてやるからね……ゼロス
traducao: Today's the day I'm gonna give you\na verrry harsh\npunishment... Zelos.

original: あああ〜〜〜っ！！
traducao: Aaaaaahhhhh!!

original: おい、しいな！\n服のそこんところ破けてんぞ！
traducao: Hey, Sheena!\nYour clothes are torn right there!

original: えっ！？　ど、どこだい？
traducao: Eh!? W-Where?

original: そこだよそこ、ほら端の！
traducao: Right there, on the edge!

original: え？　え？\nも、もっと具体的に言っとくれよ。\nそれじゃちっともわからな……
traducao: Huh? What?\nT-Tell me more specifically.\nI can't tell where...

original: ゼ、ゼロスーーーー！！
traducao: Z-Zelos!!

original: あいつ……。\nこの次見つけたら、\nただじゃおかないよ！！
traducao: That guy...\nThe next time I find him,\nI won't let him off easy!!

original: 見つけたよ、ゼロス！\nさっきはよくも騙してくれたね！
traducao: Found you, Zelos!\nHow dare you trick me earlier!

original: 騙すなんてそんな、人聞きの悪い
traducao: Tricking you? Don't make me sound so bad.

original: 衣服に万一乱れがあっちゃ、\n後で気付いたしいなが、それはそれは\n恥ずかし〜〜い思いをすると思って
traducao: If your clothes were messed up,\nI thought you'd be\nsoooo embarrassed when you noticed later.

original: これでも、俺さまなりに気を遣ったんだぜ？
traducao: I was just being considerate, y'know?

original: ……で。\n結局どこが乱れてたっていうんだい
traducao: ...So.\nWhere was it messed up in the end?

original: それは、ヒ・ミ・ツ∀
traducao: That's a se-cret!

original: どあぁっ！！？
traducao: Dwaaah!!?

original: ったくも〜〜。\n俺さま何回どつかれんのよ……
traducao: Good grief~\nHow many times am I gonna get hit...

original: 久々の再会に、喜びを抑えきれないのは\nよ〜〜くわかるんだけどさぁ
traducao: I knooow you can't contain your joy\nabout our reunion after so long, but...

original: 何だって？
traducao: What was that?

original: ああ、いや……何でもないです
traducao: Ah, no... it's nothing.

original: ……とにかく。\nアドリビトムへ来るんだろ？
traducao: ...Anyway.\nYou're coming to Ad Libitum, right?

original: 案内するから、\n黙ってちゃっちゃと歩いとくれよ
traducao: I'll show you the way,\nso shut up and walk quickly.

original: わかってますって
traducao: I know, I know.

original: 返事が軽い
traducao: You say that too lightly.

original: な、何だよそれ〜
traducao: W-What's that supposed to mean~

original: これでも、ちゃあんと感謝してるぜ？\n俺さまを迎えに来てくれた\nしいなには特別、な
traducao: I really am grateful, y'know?\nEspecially to Sheena\nfor coming to pick me up.

original: はいはい
traducao: Yeah, yeah.

original: さ、○○。\n戻ろうか
traducao: Come on, ○○.\nLet's head back.

original: ははっ。\n相変わらずつれないねぇ……
traducao: Haha.\nCold as always, huh...

original: さてさて。\nそんじゃ、早速俺さまも挨拶回りに\n行ってくるとしますかね
traducao: Well then.\nI think I'll go around and give my\ngreetings right away.

original: 待ちな、ゼロス！\n念の為に言っとくよ
traducao: Hold on, Zelos!\nI'll tell you just in case.

original: ここで何か間違いでも起こしてみな、\nその時は……わかってるだろうね？
traducao: If you try any funny business here,\nthen... you know what'll happen, right?

original: はいはい、わかってますよ
traducao: Yes, yes, I know.

original: だがよ、真面目なのも悪かねえが\nあんまりおカタい女は嫌われるぜぇ？
traducao: But y'know, being serious isn't bad,\nbut women who are too stiff are hated!

original: なっ！
traducao: Wh-!

original: んじゃ、お先〜〜∀
traducao: Well, see ya~!

original: あっ！
traducao: Ah!

original: ……もう、またやられたよ
traducao: ...Jeez, he got me again.

original: ……うるさい奴だろ？　あいつ
traducao: ...He's a noisy guy, isn't he?

original: でも、ああ見えて\n根は悪い奴じゃないからさ。\n仲良くしてやっとくれよ
traducao: But despite how he looks,\nhe's not a bad guy at heart.\nPlease try to get along with him.

original: 今日は手伝ってくれてありがとう。\nそれじゃ
traducao: Thanks for helping out today.\nWell then.

original: あ、そうそう。\n言い忘れたけど。\n俺さま、ゼロス・ワイルダーね
traducao: Oh, right, right.\nI forgot to tell you.\nI'm Zelos Wilder.

original: しばらく世話んなると思うけど、\nま、よろしくな
traducao: I'll be in your care for a while,\nso, nice to meet ya.

original: ほんじゃまぁ、\n改めて、俺さまのハニー達に\n会いに行ってくるとしますか∀∀
traducao: Well then,\nI think I'll go see my honeys\nnow!

original: ひゃっほ〜〜〜い！！
traducao: Yahoooo!!

original: ゼロスがアドリビトムに加入しました
traducao: Zelos joined Ad Libitum.
